'''Jeb Maris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[TIE pilot]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Actually the Empire knows our location, and anyone else who is listening. I'm actually trying to establish a communication network with other hold out camps in the quarantine zone. That way if anyone else goes down, we can direct them to the closest defensive position.|Jeb Maris, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DR" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jeb Maris was a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bomber]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="SWG:DR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection. The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref>

[[File:Camp_Alpha_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Camp Alpha]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]

In the meantime, Jeb Maris' TIE [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was dispatched in the area. However, an inexperienced TIE pilot rammed Maris' TIE bomber and clipped its wing. Jeb Maris eventually crashed in the Quarantine Zone. The pilot later took shelter in [[Camp Alpha]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> along with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mika Horn]]<ref name="SWG:FWAC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Forward Watch, Alpha Camp}}</ref> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:DCACA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Canisters Around Camp Alpha|Dathomir}}</ref>

Jeb Maris was stuck in the Quarantine Zone with a number of [[Radionics|radios]] that allowed him to communicate with people on the outside of the Quarantine Zone. However, the pilot knew there were other refugee camps in the Quarantine Zone and decided to establish a communication network with the other survivors. Maris therefore recruited spacers who had ventured in the Quarantine Zone and tasked them with delivering radios to the other camps. The spacers brought radios to [[Volo Madine]] in [[Camp Beta]], [[Tripp D'jek]] in [[Camp Gamma]], [[TR-522]] in [[Camp Delta]], and finally [[Sogan Varga]] in [[Camp Epsilon]]. Once communications were established in the five camps, the survivors were able to safely coordinate high altitude supply drops sent from outside the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jeb Maris was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jeb Maris was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
